name: 使用 SAP Ariba Contracts 的集中采购合同 (4B0)
name_en: Contract for Central Procurement with SAP Ariba Contracts (4B0)
description_en_html:
Overview

In this scope item, you can integrate value and quantity contracts. These are agreements for a company to order certain quantities of products during a specified period. In SAP Ariba Contracts, users can negotiate prices for goods and lean services to be procured, and they can sign a legally binding contract with a supplier. Pricing details are passed on from SAP Ariba Contracts to the operational system, so that operational purchasers can use these prices to buy goods or services as required.

Central procurement offers a centralized contract process across industries with a deep integration into the customer's landscape. It connects SAP Ariba Contracts to the customer’s ERP or SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition systems, and exchanges business documents to ensure end-to-end business processes into finance and logistics that run in the connected systems.

Key Process Flow

  • Create contract in SAP Ariba Contracts
  • Set up and review contract terms
  • Approve contract
  • Send contract to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
  • Create operational purchase contract automatically
  • Approve and release operational purchase contract automatically
  • Use operational purchase contract as source of supply
  • Create purchase order against operational purchase contract

Business Benefits

  • Manage purchase contracts for materials and lean services
  • Automate and accelerate the contract life cycle
  • Standardize and control contract development
  • Minimize effort for tracking and administration of contracts
  • Optimize the value of contracts by supporting full-scale reporting
  • Strengthen operational, contractual, and regulatory compliance
  • Reduce TCO significantly for procurement departments through centralized process
description_zh_html:
概览

在此范围项目中，您可以集成价值和数量合同。这些是公司在指定期间内订购特定数量产品的协议。在 SAP Ariba Contracts 中，用户可以协商要采购的货物和精简服务的价格，并且可以与供应商签订具有法律约束力的合同。定价详细信息从 SAP Ariba Contracts 传递到操作系统，以便操作采购员可以根据需要使用这些价格购买商品或服务。

集中采购提供跨行业的集中合同流程，并深度集成到客户架构。它将 SAP Ariba Contracts 连接到客户的 ERP 或 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统，并交换业务凭证以确保在连接的系统中运行的财务和物流的端到端业务流程。

关键流程流

  • 在 SAP Ariba Contracts 中创建合同
  • 设置和审核合同条款
  • 审批合同
  • 将合同发送到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
  • 自动创建运营采购合同
  • 自动审批和审批运营采购合同
  • 使用运营采购合同作为货源
  • 根据运营采购合同创建采购订单

业务优势

  • 管理物料和精简服务的采购合同
  • 自动化并加速合同生命周期
  • 标准化和控制合同制定
  • 最大限度地减少跟踪和管理合同的工作量
  • 通过支持全面的报告，优化合同的价值
  • 加强运营、合同和法规合规性
  • 通过集中流程显著降低采购部门的总体拥有成本
